crossRefs.note: Jesus said to him, “If you can believe, all things are possible to him who believes.”
Hurry, escape there, for I can’t do anything until you get there.” Therefore the name of the city was called Zoar.
When he saw that he didn’t prevail against him, the man touched the hollow of his thigh, and the hollow of Jacob’s…
Behold, Yahweh’s hand is not shortened, that it can’t save; nor his ear dull, that it can’t hear.
But your iniquities have separated you and your God, and your sins have hidden his face from you, so that he will not…
He didn’t do many mighty works there because of their unbelief.
For indeed we have had good news preached to us, even as they also did, but the word they heard didn’t profit them…

translations.web: He could do no mighty work there, except that he laid his hands on a few sick people, and healed them.
translations.bsb: So He could not perform any miracles there, except to lay His hands on a few of the sick and heal them.
translations.kjv: And he could there do no mighty work, save that he laid his hands upon a few sick folk, and healed
